exposure: mode of delivery (repeat cesarean section vs. vaginal birth after cesarean section (VBAC))
finding: Infants delivered by VBAC had lower odds of developing respiratory illness, otitis media, and allergies compared with infants born by repeat cesarean section.
mod_finding: Infants delivered by VBAC had lower odds of developing respiratory illness, otitis media, and allergies compared with infants born by repeat cesarean section.
